parsed.name: iChrome MLE多激光引擎
parsed.description: 一体化多激光光源系统，可集成多个激光通道并统一控制输出，常用于显微成像、荧光激发及其他需要多波长激光照明的实验。
parsed.description_en: An integrated multi-laser light source that combines multiple laser channels in one unit with centralized output control. It is commonly used for microscopy, fluorescence excitation, and other experiments requiring multi-wavelength laser illumination.

actions.description: 获取设备内各个激光通道或子设备列表。
actions.description_en: Get the list of laser channels or sub-devices available in the unit.
